common_input: the same allowlisted NormalizedEvent stream and run boundaries used by EB3; labels, health, scenario metadata, and split fields are unavailable

EB1.name: time_only
EB1.membership: one episode per nonempty window_index; all admitted events in that window
EB1.revision_rule: one terminal revision emitted at run_end_time+120 seconds; no late revision
EB1.failure: missing/invalid run bounds or event outside bounds is counted in RT7 and excluded from EB1

EB2.name: time_plus_entity
EB2.entity_key: UTF8(entity_type)||0x1f||UTF8(entity_id) for every nonempty canonical subject/object entity tuple
EB2.edge: within one EB1 window, connect two events iff their exact entity-key sets intersect
EB2.component: undirected transitive connected component; an event with no entity key is a singleton
EB2.component_order: ascending minimum canonical event-order tuple in the component
EB2.revision_rule: one terminal revision per component emitted at run_end_time+120 seconds; no cross-window merge or late revision
EB2.failure: malformed entity tuple is ignored and counted; if all tuples are malformed the event is a singleton

SB1.name: maximum_source_native_severity
SB1.input_contract: finite binary64 in [0,1], produced by the manifest-pinned parser; larger is more severe
SB1.deduplication: one value per dependency_group; conflicting values reject the candidate
SB1.candidate_score: maximum value over root-deduplicated events in the EpisodeRevision
SB1.tie_order: descending score, then ascending episode_id UTF-8 bytes, then revision
SB1.missing: candidate score undefined and candidate excluded from SB1 metrics with count reported

SB2.name: constrained_D_only_logit
SB2.feature: the exact frozen D used by SB3
SB2.cohort: the exact C_dec_binary training cohort used by SB3
SB2.candidate_score: b+w_D*D; no sigmoid or calibration for RT3a ranking
